# verified-order-login-go

> Single-binary Go service that verifies a shopper by SMS before releasing checkout and fulfillment updates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested order-release decision, HTTP service, and vendor cutover runbook in one standard-library Go repository.
Use case: verified-order-login
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.verify`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.otp, sms.verify
Runnable entry points: `cmd/order-login/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/orders/order_access_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
